baseline.build: git archive of both gitlinks, compiled C and C++ parsers, independent module resolution

candidate.build: uncommitted worktree, source and compiled parsers copied before benchmark

measurement.clock: elapsed real time from CLI process spawn to exit, fresh process and output directory per sample; no saved graph or saved UAST; OS filesystem cache not flushed
measurement.small_protocol: Three successive pairs per project, baseline then candidate or reverse in alternating order. Each run completes before the next starts. Median elapsed time computed per version.
measurement.large_protocol: A long-budget legacy libcurl run completed after the 180 s timeout. The nauty and SQLite baseline runs used the original 180 s cap. For the candidate, libcurl was repeated three times; nauty and SQLite twice. Compare endpoints on the same Mac, serially; host background load was uncontrolled. The legacy libcurl sample occurred before the candidate sequence. Stage times are YASA internal wall-clock milliseconds.
measurement.eligibility: Complete JSON graph required for node/edge counts; exit 0 and error log checked independently. Timeouts are censored.

jansson.scope: Jansson 2.14 static library, 12 build-selected translation units, internal/public and generated headers

zlib.scope: zlib 1.4 zlibstatic, all 15 library translation units and top-level headers, CMake-generated zconf.h

espresso.scope: All 36 C implementation files selected by setup.py for the Espresso core, plus 7 headers. Excludes standalone CLI and CPython wrapper.

full_ast_direct_pair_recall.note: Clang syntactic AST includes macros, compile-time checking helpers and path-infeasible branches; this supplementary measure does not assert runtime reachability.

nauty.scope: Complete default nauty.a static library (15 translation units), the configure-generated native headers, all local transitive includes and the sorttemplates.c include-only fragment.

sqlite.scope: SQLite core amalgamation and both shipped headers, default engine features

notes.scope: C call graph export under the indicated build flags. Clang direct internal calls form a partial reference. Indirect targets are separately tested using a compiler-executed finite fixture and the curated libcurl labels.
notes.macro_template_limit: Seven physical function names generated by re-including sorttemplates.c with different macros in different nauty translation units; 15 unique direct function pairs in the native oracle refer to them.

watch_equivalence.method: Differ only by the namespace-join fast path, full CLI export at fixed intermediate source snapshot

sqlite_remaining.false_positive: May report sqlite3IsIdChar at sqlite3.c:208219 from the alternative macro implementation. The native ASCII build expands to a table lookup.
sqlite_remaining.unreachable_syntactic_edge: pager_incr_changecounter → sqlite3OsWrite at sqlite3.c:63675 is guarded by DIRECT_MODE, which is zero for this build.

notes.zlib_remaining: The indirect call at deflate.c:1239 additionally resolves deflate_stored; level==0 already dispatches that target at 1236. This is a site-level false positive, even though the enclosing pair is a genuine edge.

details.classification: Four resolved removed entries attributed hash.c:350 or 401 to functions ending at lines 329 and 320 respectively. All four targets occur in the final graph under the correct Clang lexical caller. The two other removed entries are unresolved at the same wrongly attributed sites.

notes.nauty_remaining: The 7 macro-template function names account for 19 missing direct call lines. A further 8 call lines in traces.c are missing for pairs recovered at other sites.
